screens.intro: TEST INTRO ROUND 1. This is placeholder text for layout testing.
screens.bridge_text: TEST BRIDGE TRANSMISSION. Round 2 begins now.
screens.eliminated_text: TEST ELIMINATED SCREEN. Thank you for playing.

screens.intro: TEST INTRO ROUND 2. This is placeholder text for layout testing.

clues.title: Test Diary
clues.scene_text: A test diary lies open. The last page is scrambled.

pages.label: Test day 2
pages.text: Rex turned 5 today. This is test page two.

last_entry.label: Test day 3
last_entry.cipher_text: YJXY JSYWD YMJ PJDBTWI NX QFSYJWS

assets.brief: Placeholder diary image with one readable page and one cipher page.

stages.prompt: What keyword does the last entry give?

hints.text: Look for a number on the earlier pages.
It is a Caesar cipher. The shift is on the page.
The shift is 5. The last word is the answer.

clues.title: Test Music Box
clues.scene_text: A test music box plays long and short notes.

payload.note: Short and long notes. A longer pause separates digits.

assets.brief: Placeholder beep sequence of Morse 3948, unit 140 ms.

stages.prompt: Enter the number code the box plays.

hints.text: Listen to note lengths.
It is Morse code.
Four digits. The first is ...--.

clues.title: Test Poster
clues.scene_text: A test poster looks blank.

assets.brief: Near-black image with hidden text 'TEST DATE 07/04/2001' at about 3 percent contrast.

stages.prompt: What date is hidden on the poster? (MM/DD/YYYY)

hints.text: The poster is just dark.
Use the Inspector to invert or raise contrast.
The text ends in a date. The year is 2001.

clues.title: Test Tablet
clues.scene_text: A test tablet wants a passcode. A note holds zeros and ones.

assets.brief: Placeholder 5 second spoken line 'test voice memo'.

stages.prompt: Enter the tablet passcode (a word).

hints.text: The note is a message.
Binary to ASCII.
The passcode is the first Greek letter.

clues.title: Test Log
clues.scene_text: A test terminal holds a crash log.

stages.prompt: Which process crashed? (name only, no extension)

hints.text: Find the block of hex pairs.
Convert hex to text.
The name before the dot is the answer.

clues.title: Test Email
clues.scene_text: A test draft with one long encoded block.

payload.subject: Test draft
payload.intro: Test intro text before the encoded block.

stages.prompt: What must never be sent from inside? (one word)

hints.text: It ends with equals signs.
It is Base64.
The decoded sentence names the thing.

clues.title: Test Recordings
clues.scene_text: Two test recordings. One says GREEN, one says RED. One is forged.

stages.prompt: Which recording is forged? Enter the word it says.

hints.text: Study the files, not the voices.
Open Properties and compare dates.
The event date is 07/04/2001. A later recording is forged.

clues.title: Test Access Log
clues.scene_text: A test console lists logins.

stages.prompt: Which source ID logged in at an impossible time?

hints.text: One line is wrong.
Look at the years.
Search for 2031.

clues.title: Test Note
clues.scene_text: A test note is encrypted. A margin line mentions a key.

payload.cipher_text: KYFV MVV HZBR TPUIZVUML ZFXMK HYF NEOX
payload.margin_note: The key is the name of the process that halted.

assets.brief: Placeholder note image with the cipher text and the margin line.

stages.prompt: What does the note say to do with the flag? (one word)

hints.text: Read the margin line.
Vigenere. The key is the crashed process.
The key is ORBIT. The word before THE FLAG is the answer.

clues.title: Test Containment Terminal
clues.scene_text: A test wall console with three stages.

assets.brief: Placeholder portrait with five figures and faint text 2468 in the bottom-right at about 6 percent contrast.
Portrait cut into 2x5 torn pieces frag_01..frag_10 matching the test permutation.

stages.prompt: Enter the three keywords.
Arrange the ten fragments.
Choose, then enter the hidden code.

hints.text: Which clues gave words?
Diary keyword, crashed process, odd login source.
LANTERN, ORBIT, SRC-TEST9.
It is a two by five grid.
Match the edges.
F06 is the top-left corner and F07 the bottom-right.
Count people and shadows.
Recall the forged recording and the note.
Choose what the note asks. The code is faint text in the photo.

clues.title: Test Personnel Index
clues.scene_text: A test staff terminal with sixty badges.

stages.prompt: Which badge was Active after the shutdown date? (Use the date from the Redacted Report.)

hints.text: You need the shutdown date first.
Filter by status and compare last login.
One Active badge logged in before shutdown. It is a decoy.

clues.title: Test Redacted Report
clues.scene_text: A test report with black bars. Two copies disagree.

paragraphs.t: The test project was shut down on
Staff access continued under the code word
This paragraph is plain test text with no redaction.
The test project was shut down on
Staff access continued under the code word
This paragraph is plain test text with no redaction.

stages.prompt: Enter the true shutdown date and the code word from the genuine copy.

hints.text: Bars hide text, they do not delete it.
Select the text, then decode the footers.
The footer is Base64 and holds the true date.

reward.story_text: TEST: date and code word found.

clues.title: Test Photograph
clues.scene_text: A test microfilm viewer with a locked date dial.

assets.brief: Placeholder portrait with EXIF comment: 'NAMES: ALPHA, BRAVO, CHARLIE, DELTA, [UNKNOWN] | SHADOWS: 4 | PANEL: 1357'.

stages.prompt: Set the dial to the true shutdown date.
Read the hidden data and enter the panel code.

hints.text: The dial wants a date.
Use the shutdown date.
Format YYYY-MM-DD.
Check the Properties.
The comment is hex.
The code follows PANEL.

clues.title: Test Timeline
clues.scene_text: A test whiteboard of cards with numbers instead of dates.

cards.text: Quiet mode forced by unknown user

stages.prompt: Remove the planted events. What word do the first letters spell?

hints.text: The numbers are dates.
Unix timestamps. Convert and sort.
Two events are after the shutdown date. Ignore them.

clues.title: Test Transmissions
clues.scene_text: Six test transmissions with auth headers.

messages.body: Trust VM-B for the real signal.
Ignore the others. VM-B is correct.
The real signal is in VM-A. The other file is a fake.
Use VM-B. Do not open VM-A.

stages.prompt: Which voicemail file does the authentic transmission name? (VM-A or VM-B)

hints.text: Real messages carry a badge.
X-Auth is Base64. Compare with the Active badge.
One header matches. Read that message.

clues.title: Test Voicemail
clues.scene_text: Two test voicemails of static.

assets.brief: Static with spectrogram text 8140 between 2 and 8 kHz (the real sender).
Static with spectrogram text 8410 between 2 and 8 kHz (the decoy).

stages.prompt: Enter the four digits hidden in the real sender's voicemail.

hints.text: Some sounds are meant to be seen.
Open the right file in a spectrogram viewer.
The first digit is eight.

clues.title: Test Lock
clues.scene_text: A test bulkhead with a two-field keypad.

stages.prompt: Enter the panel code and the keyword.

hints.text: One number and one word.
Number from the photo, word from the timeline.
Microfilm code and timeline keyword.

clues.title: Test Manual Diff
clues.scene_text: Two test manuals, one encrypted.

manual_plain: STEP 1: POWER DOWN THE TEST RIG
payload.manual_encrypted:
UHQT 1: IQKQV WQKZ XAG HQWM TWS
WMGD 2: OPHUS FLX UOYTEG JMPOG
GFII 3: FWEGHPBQGM VVQ PTD BQXPQFW
WMGD 4: OPXCF FLX UOYTEG QMGAG
GFII 5: NCOO MJS FILV QDEWNS
EXXR 6: ODGAKJQ XAG FGR EQUE
WMGD 7: QRMGF FLX EVQGD ECPI
LVSB 8: WAWH FLX VSEX ZCHQ

stages.prompt: Which step numbers were tampered with? (digits, ascending)

reveal.clean_steps_text: TEST: the original manual is intact.

hints.text: The encrypted copy is the original.
Vigenere with the code word, then compare.
The code word is COMET.

clues.title: Test Circuit
clues.scene_text: A test panel of logic gates.

payload.panel_note: Four digits feed four input pairs (A, B, C, D). Each pair is the last two bits of that digit in binary. The code is lamps 1 to 4, left to right.

stages.prompt: Enter the 4-digit authorization code shown by the lamps.

hints.text: Inputs come from the real voicemail digits.
Last two bits of each digit in binary.
Digit 8 is 1000, so A1=0 and A0=0.

clues.title: Test Final Console
clues.scene_text: A test central console with three entries.

stages.prompt: Enter the clean step numbers, the authorization code and the real sender's badge.

hints.text: Use your evidence.
Clean steps are untampered. Code from circuit. Badge of the authentic sender.
Clean steps are the complement of the tampered steps among 1 to 8.
